bio: There is no better place to enjoy the beloved tradition of Afternoon Tea than at the historic country house of Chilston Park Hotel, Kent.  Allow yourself to be outrageously indulgent as you devour a selection of carefully prepared pastries, sandwiches and the finest leaf tea. For that extra special occasion, you can also choose to take afternoon tea in one of our private dining rooms.  At Chilston Park Hotel, Lenham, Kent, Afternoon Tea is enjoyed in either the Marble Lounge with its beautiful chandeliers, or the Culpeper Restaurant which still retains original dining room features from the 17th Century.  Chilston Park Hotel is easily accessible from the motorway and is a short drive from Lenham rail station.
